arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,

arabic: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation: Verily, We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people (Saying): “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment.”

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation: He said: “O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: “That you should worship Allah (Alone), be dutiful to Him, and obey me,

arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation: “He (Allah) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allah when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew.”

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation: He said: “O my Lord! Verily, I have called my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islamic Monotheism) ,

arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation: “But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).

arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation: “And verily! Every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation: “Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud);

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation: “Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private,

arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation: “I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord; Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;

arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation: ‘He will send rain to you in abundance;

arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation: ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’ “

arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation: What is the matter with you, [that you fear not Allah (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allah or you believe not in His Oneness).

arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation: While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14) the Qur’an].

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation: See you not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,

arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation: And Allah has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth. [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol.29, Page 97].

arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation: And Allah has made for you the earth wide spread (an expanse).

arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation: That you may go about therein in broad roads.

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation: Nuh (Noah) said: “My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but only loss.

arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation: “And they have plotted a mighty plot.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation: “And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwa’, nor Yaghuth, nor Ya’uq, nor Nasr (names of the idols);

arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation: “And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allah): ‘Grant no increase to the Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers, etc.) save error.’ “

arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire, and they found none to help them instead of Allah.

arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
translation: And Nuh (Noah) said: “My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!

arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
translation: “If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers.”

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
translation: “My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers, etc.) grant You no increase but destruction!”

arabic: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
translation: Say (O Muhammad ): “It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinns listened (to this Qur’an). They said: ‘Verily! We have heard a wonderful Recital (this Qur’an)!

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
translation: ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allah).

arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
translation: ‘And exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, He has taken neither a wife, nor a son (or offspring or children).

arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
translation: ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblis (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinns] used to utter against Allah that which was wrong and not right.

arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
translation: ‘And verily, we thought that men and jinns would not utter a lie against Allah.

arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
translation: ‘And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the masculine among the jinns, but they (jinns) increased them (mankind) in sin and disbelief.

arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
translation: ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allah will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinns).

arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
translation: ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.

arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
translation: ‘And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.

arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
translation: ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
translation: ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups each having a different way (religious sect, etc.).

arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
translation: ‘And we think that we cannot escape (from the punishment of) Allah in the earth, nor can we escape (from the punishment) by flight.

arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
translation: ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’an), we believed therein (Islamic Monotheism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in punishment for his sins.

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
translation: ‘And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allah, after listening to this Qur’an), and of us some are Al-Qasitun (disbelievers those who have deviated from the Right Path)’. And whosoever has embraced Islam (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allah), then such have sought the Right Path.”

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
translation: And as for the Qasitun (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path), they shall be firewood for Hell,

arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
translation: If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allah, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islam) We should surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance.

arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
translation: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’an, and practice not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell).

arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
translation: And the mosques are for Allah (Alone), so invoke not anyone along with Allah.

arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
translation: (It has been revealed to me that) When the slave of Allah (Muhammad ) stood up invoking (his Lord Allah) in prayer to Him they (the jinns) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (in order to listen to the Prophet’s recitation).

arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
translation: Say (O Muhammad ): “I invoke only my Lord (Allah Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him.”

arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
translation: Say: “It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path.”

arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
translation: Say (O Muhammad ): “None can protect me from Allah’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him.

arabic: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
translation: “(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allah and His Messages (of Islamic Monotheism), and whosoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, then verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever .”

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
translation: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.

arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
translation: Say (O Muhammad ): “I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.

arabic: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
translation: “(He Alone) the All-Knower of the Gha’ib (unseen), and He reveals to none His Gha’ib (unseen).”

arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
translation: Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him.

arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
translation: [He (Allah) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allah). And He (Allah) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allah) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything).

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
translation: O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muhammad )!

arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
translation: Stand (to pray) all night, except a little.

arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
translation: Half of it, or a little less than that,

arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
translation: Or a little more; and recite the Qur’an (aloud) in a slow, (pleasant tone and) style .

arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
translation: Verily, We shall send down to you a weighty Word (i.e. obligations, legal laws, etc.).

arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
translation: Verily, the rising by night (for Tahajjud prayer) is very hard and most potent and good for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (understanding) the Word (of Allah).

arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
translation: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties,

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
translation: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
translation: (He Alone is) the Lord of the east and the west, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). So take Him Alone as Wakil (Disposer of your affairs) .

arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
translation: And be patient (O Muhammad ) with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.

arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses, etc.), and those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.

arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation: Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.

arabic: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad ) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Musa (Moses)] to Fir’aun (Pharaoh) .

arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation: But Fir’aun (Pharaoh) disobeyed the Messenger [Musa (Moses)], so We seized him with a severe punishment.

arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation: Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day that will make the children grey-headed (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?

arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation: Verily, this is an admonition, therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!

arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
translation: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so do a party of those with you, And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Qur’an as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah’s Bounty; yet others fighting in Allah’s Cause. So recite as much of the Qur’an as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and give Zakat, and lend to Allah a goodly loan, and whatever good you send before you for yourselves, (i.e. Nawafil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and ‘Umrah, etc.), you will certainly find it with Allah, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allah. Verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Mercifu

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
translation: O you (Muhammad ) enveloped (in garments)!

arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
translation: Arise and warn!

arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
translation: And your Lord (Allah) magnify!

arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
translation: And your garments purify!

arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
translation: And keep away from Ar-Rujz (the idols)!

arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
translation: And give not a thing in order to have more (or consider not your deeds of Allah’s obedience as a favour to Allah).

arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
translation: And be patient for the sake of your Lord (i.e. perform your duty to Allah)!

arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
translation: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded (i.e. its second blowing);

arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
translation: Truly, that Day will be a Hard Day.

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
translation: Far from easy for the disbelievers.

arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
translation: Leave Me Alone (to deal) with whom I created Alone (without any means, i.e. Al-Walid bin Al-Mughirah Al-Makhzumi)!

arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation: And then granted him resources in abundance.

arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation: And children to be by his side!

arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation: And made life smooth and comfortable for him!

arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation: After all that he desires that I should give more;

arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation: Nay! Verily, he has been stubborn and opposing Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.).

arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation: I shall oblige him to (climb a slippery mountain in the Hell-fire called As-Sa’ud, or to) face a severe torment!

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation: Verily, he thought and plotted;

arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation: So let him be cursed! How he plotted!

arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation: And once more let him be cursed, how he plotted!

arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation: Then he thought;

arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation: Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation: Then he turned back and was proud;

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation: Then he said: “This is nothing but magic from that of old;

arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation: “This is nothing but the word of a human being!”

arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
translation: I will cast him into Hell-fire

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
translation: And what will make you know exactly what Hell-fire is?

arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
translation: It spares not (any sinner), nor does it leave (anything unburnt)!

arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
translation: Burning the skins!

arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
translation: Over it are nineteen (angels as guardians and keepers of Hell).

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation: And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire, and We have fixed their number (19) only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may arrive at a certainty [that this Qur’an is the truth as it agrees with their Books i.e. their number (19) is written in the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] and the believers may increase in Faith (as this Qur’an is the truth) and that no doubts may be left for the people of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy) and the disbelievers may say: “What Allah intends by this (curious) example ?” Thus Allah leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this (Hell) is nothing else than a (warning) reminder to mankind.

arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
translation: Nay, and by the moon,

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
translation: And by the night when it withdraws,

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
translation: And by the dawn when it brightens,

arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
translation: Verily, it (Hell, or their denial of the Prophet Muhammad , or the Day of Resurrection) is but one of the greatest calamities.

arabic: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ
translation: A warning to mankind,

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
translation: To any of you that chooses to go forward (by working righteous deeds), or to remain behind (by commiting sins),

arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
translation: Every person is a pledge for what he has earned,

arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation: Except those on the Right, (i.e. the pious true believers of Islamic Monotheism);

arabic: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation: In Gardens (Paradise) they will ask one another,

arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation: About Al-Mujrimun (polytheists, criminals, disbelievers, etc.), (And they will say to them):

arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
translation: “What has caused you to enter Hell?”

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation: They will say: “We were not of those who used to offer their Salat (prayers)

arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
translation: “Nor we used to feed Al-Miskin (the poor);

arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation: “And we used to talk falsehood (all that which Allah hated) with vain talkers .

arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: “And we used to belie the Day of Recompense

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation: “Until there came to us (the death) that is certain.”

arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.

arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation: Then what is wrong with them (i.e. the disbelievers) that they turn away from (receiving) admonition?

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation: As if they were frightened (wild) donkeys.

arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation: Fleeing from a hunter, or a lion, or a beast of prey.

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation: Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out (coming from Allah with a writing that Islam is the right religion, and Muhammad has come with the truth from Allah the Lord of the heavens and earth, etc.).

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation: Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter (from Allah’s punishment).

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation: Nay, verily, this (Qur’an) is an admonition,

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation: So whosoever will (let him read it), and receive admonition (from it)!

arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation: And they will not receive admonition unless Allah wills; He (Allah) is the One, deserving that mankind should be afraid of, and should be dutiful to Him, and should not take any Ilah (God) along with Him, and He is the One Who forgives (sins).

arabic: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation: And I swear by the self-reproaching person (a believer).

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation: Does man (a disbeliever) think that We shall not assemble his bones?

arabic: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation: Yes, We are Able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation: Nay! (Man denies Resurrection and Reckoning. So) he desires to continue committing sins.

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation: He asks: “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”

arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation: So, when the sight shall be dazed,

arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation: And the moon will be eclipsed,

arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation: And the sun and moon will be joined together (by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light, etc.)

arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation: On that Day man will say: “Where (is the refuge) to flee?”

arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation: No! There is no refuge!

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation: Unto your Lord (Alone) will be the place of rest that Day.

arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward (of his evil or good deeds), and what he left behind (of his good or evil traditions).

arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation: Nay! Man will be a witness against himself [as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds].

arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation: Though he may put forth his excuses (to cover his evil deeds).

arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation: Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur’an, O Muhammad ) to make haste therewith.

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation: It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muhammad ) the ability to recite it (the Qur’an),

arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation: And when We have recited it to you [O Muhammad through Jibrael (Gabriel)], then follow you its (the Qur’an’s) recital.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation: Then it is for Us (Allah) to make it clear to you,

arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation: Not [as you think, that you (mankind) will not be resurrected and recompensed for your deeds], but (you men) love the present life of this world,

arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation: And leave (neglect) the Hereafter.

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation: Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah (shining and radiant).

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation: Looking at their Lord (Allah);

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation: And some faces, that Day, will be Basirah (dark, gloomy, frowning, and sad),

arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation: Thinking that some calamity was about to fall on them;

arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation: Nay, when (the soul) reaches to the collar bone (i.e. up to the throat in its exit),

arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation: And it will be said: “Who can cure him and save him from death?”

arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation: And he (the dying person) will conclude that it was (the time) of departing (death);

arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation: And leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded)

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation: The drive will be, on that Day, to your Lord (Allah)!

arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation: So he (the disbeliever) neither believed (in this Qur’an, in the Message of Muhammad ) nor prayed!

arabic: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation: But on the contrary, he belied (this Qur’an and the Message of Muhammad ) and turned away!

arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation: Then he walked in full pride to his family admiring himself!

arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation: Woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!

arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation: Again, woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation: Does man think that he will be left Suda [neglected without being punished or rewarded for the obligatory duties enjoined by his Lord (Allah) on him]?

arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation: Was he not a Nutfah (mixed male and female discharge of semen) poured forth?

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation: Then he became an ‘Alaqa (a clot); then (Allah) shaped and fashioned (him) in due proportion.

arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation: And made him in two sexes, male and female.

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation: Is not He (Allah Who does that), Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things).

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was nothing to be mentioned?

arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah drops of mixed semen (discharge of man and woman), in order to try him, so We made him hearer, seer.

arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation: Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation: Verily, the Abrar (pious, who fear Allah and avoid evil), shall drink a cup (of wine) mixed with water from a spring in Paradise called Kafur.

arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.

arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation: They (are those who) fulfill (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.

arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation: And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to Miskin (poor), the orphan, and the captive,

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation: (Saying): “We feed you seeking Allah’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you.

arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation: “Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislikeness to it).”

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation: So Allah saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadratan (a light of beauty) and joy.

arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.

arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation: Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon).

arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.

arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal,

arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation: Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof according to their wishes.

arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation: And they will be given to drink there a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabil (ginger, etc.),

arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation: A spring there, called Salsabil.

arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.

arabic: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation: (And it will be said to them): “Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted.”

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation: Verily! It is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you (O Muhammad ) by stages.

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation: Therefore be patient (O Muhammad ) and submit to the Command of your Lord (Allah, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers].

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Isha’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer).

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation: Verily! These (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard).

arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation: Verily! This (Verses of the Qur’an) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allah).

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation: But you cannot will, unless Allah wills. Verily, Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.

arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will and as for the Zalimun, (polytheists, wrong-doers, etc.) He has prepared a painful torment.

arabic: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation: By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allah) sent forth one after another.

arabic: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation: And by the winds that blow violently,

arabic: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain;

arabic: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation: And by the Verses (of the Qur’an) that separate the right from the wrong.

arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,

arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation: To cut off all excuses or to warn;

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.

arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation: Then when the stars lose their lights;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation: And when the heaven is cleft asunder;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation: And when the mountains are blown away;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed;

arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation: For what Day are these signs postponed?

arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation: For the Day of sorting out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation: And what will explain to you what is the Day of sorting out?

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: Did We not destroy the ancients?

arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation: So shall We make later generations to follow them.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.)!

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation: Did We not create you from a worthless water (semen, etc.)?

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation: Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),

arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation: For a known period (determined by gestation)?

arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation: So We did measure, and We are the Best to measure (the things).

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
translation: Have We not made the earth a receptacle?

arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا
translation: For the living and the dead.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
translation: And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains; and have given you to drink sweet water?

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: (It will be said to the disbelievers): “Depart you to that which you used to deny!

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
translation: “Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-fire smoke ascending) in three columns,

arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
translation: “Neither shading, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire.”

arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
translation: Verily! It (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr [a fort or a Qasr (huge log of wood)],

arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
translation: As if they were Jimalatun Sufr (yellow camels or bundles of ropes).”

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
translation: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),

arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!

arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation: So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allah)!

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious – see V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.

arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation: And fruits, such as they desire.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation: “Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do.

arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinun (good-doers).

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation: (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimun (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals, etc.).

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
translation: And when it is said to them: “Bow down yourself (in prayer)!” They bow not down (offer not their prayers) .

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

arabic: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation: Then in what statement after this (the Qur’an) will they believe?

arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation: What are they asking (one another)?

arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation: About the great news, (i.e. Islamic Monotheism, the Qur’an, which Prophet Muhammad () brought and the Day of Resurrection, etc.),

arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
translation: About which they are in disagreement.

arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Nay, they will come to know!

arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Nay, again, they will come to know!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا
translation: Have We not made the earth as a bed,

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
translation: And the mountains as pegs?

arabic: وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا
translation: And We have created you in pairs (male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.).

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
translation: And have made your sleep as a thing for rest.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
translation: And have made the night as a covering (through its darkness),

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
translation: And have made the day for livelihood.

arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
translation: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
translation: And have made (therein) a shining lamp (sun).

arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا
translation: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.

arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
translation: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations,

arabic: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
translation: And gardens of thick growth.

arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا
translation: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
translation: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups);

arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا
translation: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,

arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
translation: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.

arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
translation: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush,

arabic: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا
translation: A dwelling place for the Taghun (those who transgress the boundry limits set by Allah like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals, etc.),

arabic: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا
translation: They will abide therein for ages,

arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
translation: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.

arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
translation: Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges.

arabic: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.

arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation: But they belied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet (Peace be upon him) brought) completely.

arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation: And all things We have recorded in a Book.

arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation: So taste you (the results of your evil actions); no increase shall We give you, except in torment.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation: Verily, for the Muttaqun, there will be a success (Paradise);

arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation: Gardens and grapeyards;

arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation: And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age;

arabic: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation: And a full cup (of wine).

arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying;

arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation: A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds).

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Beneficent, none can dare to speak with Him (on the Day of Resurrection except after His Leave).

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation: The Day that Ar-Ruh [Jibrael (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, none shall speak except him whom the Most Beneficent (Allah) allows, and he will speak what is right.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation: That is without doubt the True Day, so, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment, the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: “Woe to me! Would that I were dust!”

arabic: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence;

arabic: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation: By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers);

arabic: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation: And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits, etc.).

arabic: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation: And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses, etc.).

arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation: And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation: On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die),

arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation: The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be raised up),

arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation: (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.

arabic: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation: Their eyes cast down.

arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation: They say: “Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?

arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation: “Even after we are crumbled bones?”

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation: They say: “It would in that case, be a return with loss!”

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation: But only, it will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)]. (See Verse 37:19).

arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation: When, behold, they find themselves over the earth alive after their death,

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation: Has there come to you the story of Musa (Moses)?

arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation: Go to Fir’aun (Pharaoh), verily, he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief, etc.).

arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation: And say to him: “Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)”,

arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation: And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?

arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation: Then [Musa (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).

arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation: But [Fir’aun (Pharaoh)] belied and disobeyed;

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation: Then he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).

arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation: Then he gathered his people and cried aloud,

arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation: Saying: “I am your lord, most high”,

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation: So Allah, seized him with punishment for his last [i.e. his saying: “I am your lord, most high”) (see Verse 79:24)] and first [(i.e. his saying, “O chiefs! I know not that you have a god other than I” (see Verse 28:38)] transgression.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation: Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allah.

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation: Are you more difficult to create, or is the heaven that He constructed?

arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation: He raised its height, and He has equally ordered it,

arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation: Its night He covers with darkness, and its forenoon He brings out (with light).

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation: And after that He spread the earth;

arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture;

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation: And the mountains He has fixed firmly;

arabic: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation: But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense, etc.),

arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for,

arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation: And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees,

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation: Then, for him who Tagha (transgressed all bounds, in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allah).

arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation: And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation: Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires, and lusts.

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation: They ask you (O Muhammad ()) about the Hour, – when will be its appointed time?

arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation: You have no knowledge to say anything about it,

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?

arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation: You (O Muhammad ()) are only a warner for those who fear it,

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.

arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation: (The Prophet ()) frowned and turned away,

arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation: Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. ‘Abdullah bin Umm-Maktum, who came to the Prophet () while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).

arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation: But what could tell you that per chance he might become pure (from sins)?

arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation: Or that he might receive admonition, and that the admonition might profit him?

arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation: To him you attend;

arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief, you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allah).

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation: But as to him who came to you running.

arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation: And is afraid (of Allah and His Punishment),

arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation: Nay, (do not do like this), indeed it (these Verses of this Qur’an) are an admonition,

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

arabic: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz).

arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation: Exalted (in dignity), purified,

arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ
translation: In the hands of scribes (angels).

arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ
translation: Honourable and obedient.

arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
translation: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!

arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
translation: From what thing did He create him?

arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
translation: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him, and then set him in due proportion;

arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
translation: Then He makes the Path easy for him;

arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
translation: Then He causes him to die, and puts him in his grave;

arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
translation: Then, when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).

arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
translation: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
translation: Then let man look at his food,

arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا
translation: That We pour forth water in abundance,

arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
translation: And We split the earth in clefts,

arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
translation: And We cause therein the grain to grow,

arabic: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
translation: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),

arabic: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
translation: And olives and date-palms,

arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا
translation: And gardens, dense with many trees,

arabic: وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
translation: And fruits and Abba (herbage, etc.),

arabic: مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
translation: Then, when there comes As-Sakhkhah (the Day of Resurrection’s second blowing of Trumpet),

arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
translation: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,

arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
translation: And from his mother and his father,

arabic: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
translation: And from his wife and his children.

arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
translation: Everyman, that Day, will have enough to make him careless of others.

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
translation: Some faces that Day, will be bright (true believers of Islamic Monotheism).

arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
translation: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained;

arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
translation: Darkness will cover them,

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
translation: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad (), etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).

arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
translation: When the sun Kuwwirat (wound round and lost its light and is overthrown).

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
translation: And when the stars shall fall;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
translation: And when the mountains shall made to pass away;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
translation: And when the pregnant she-camels shall be neglected;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
translation: And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
translation: And when the seas shall become as blazing Fire or shall overflow;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
translation: And when the souls shall be joined with their bodies;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
translation: And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) shall be questioned.

arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ
translation: For what sin she was killed?

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
translation: And when the written pages of deeds (good and bad) of every person shall be laid open;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
translation: And when the heaven shall be stripped off and taken away from its place;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
translation: And when Hell-fire shall be kindled to fierce ablaze.

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
translation: And when Paradise shall be brought near,

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
translation: (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).

arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
translation: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).

arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
translation: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves,

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation: And by the night as it departs;

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation: And by the dawn as it brightens;

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation: Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’an brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrael (Gabriel), from Allah to the Prophet Muhammad ()].

arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation: Owner of power, and high rank with (Allah) the Lord of the Throne,

arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation: Obeyed (by the angels), trustworthy there (in the heavens).

arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation: And (O people) your companion (Muhammad ()) is not a madman;

arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation: And indeed he (Muhammad ()) saw him [Jibrael (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation: And he (Muhammad ()) withholds not a knowledge of the unseen.

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation: And it (the Qur’an) is not the word of the outcast Shaitan (Satan).

arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation: Then where are you going?

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation: Verily, this (the Qur’an) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Alamin (mankind and jinns).

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight,

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation: And you will not, unless (it be) that Allah wills, the Lord of the ‘Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).

arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder.

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation: And when the stars have fallen and scattered;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation: And when the seas are burst forth;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation: And when the graves are turned upside down (and they bring out their contents)

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation: (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation: O man! What has made you careless concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?

arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion;

arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.

arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation: Nay! But you deny the Recompense (reward for good deeds and punishment for evil deeds).

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,

arabic: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation: Kiraman (honourable) Katibin writing down (your deeds),

arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation: They know all that you do.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation: Verily, the Abrar (pious and righteous) will be in delight (Paradise);

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation: And verily, the Fujjar (the wicked, disbelievers, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),

arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: In which they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,

arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation: And they (Al-Fujjar) will not be absent therefrom (i.e. will not go out from the Hell).

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.

arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation: Woe to Al-Mutaffifin [those who give less in measure and weight (decrease the rights of others)],

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,

arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation: And when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.

arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation: Think they not that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),

arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation: On a Great Day,

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists)?

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjar (disbelievers, sinners, evil-doers and wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjin.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation: And what will make you know what Sijjin is?

arabic: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation: A Register inscribed.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe, that Day, to those who deny [(Allah, His Angels, His Books, His Messengers, the Day of Resurrection, and Al-Qadar (Divine Preordainments)].

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience of Allah, the sinner!)

arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: When Our Verses (of the Qur’an) are recited to him he says: “Tales of the ancients!”

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation: Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation: Nay! Surely, they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation: Then, verily they will indeed enter and taste the burning flame of Hell.

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: Then, it will be said to them: “This is what you used to deny!”

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation: Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrar (the pious who fear Allah and avoid evil), is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyun.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation: And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyun is?

arabic: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation: A Register inscribed.

arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation: To which bear witness those nearest (to Allah, i.e. the angels).

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation: Verily, Al-Abrar (the pious who fear Allah and avoid evil) will be in delight (Paradise).

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation: On thrones, looking (at all things).

arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.

arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation: They will be given to drink pure sealed wine.

arabic: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation: The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).

arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation: It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnim.

arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allah.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation: Verily! (During the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery);

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation: And when they saw them, they said: “Verily! These have indeed gone astray!”

arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation: But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).

arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation: On (high) thrones, looking (at all things).

arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation: Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?

arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation: When the heaven is split asunder,

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation: And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation: And when the earth is stretched forth,

arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty,

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation: And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, so you will meet (i.e. the results of your deeds which you did).

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation: Then, as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,

arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation: And will return to his family in joy!

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation: He will invoke (his) destruction,

arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation: And shall enter a blazing Fire, and made to taste its burning.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation: Verily, he was among his people in joy!

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation: Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!

arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!

arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness;

arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation: And by the moon when it is at the full,

arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).

arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?

arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation: And when the Qur’an is recited to them, they fall not prostrate,

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: Nay, (on the contrary), those who disbelieve, belie (Prophet Muhammad () and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’an and Islamic Monotheism, etc.).

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation: And Allah knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),

arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation: So announce to them a painful torment.

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation: By the heaven, holding the big stars .

arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation: And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection);

arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation: And by the witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the witnessed day [i.e. the day of ‘Arafat (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah];

arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation: Cursed were the people of the ditch (the story of the Boy and the King).

arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel,

arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation: When they sat by it (fire),

arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them).

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation: They had nothing against them, except that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!

arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation: Who, to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness over everything.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance, (to Allah), will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.

arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation: Verily, (O Muhammad ()) the Grip (Punishment) of your Lord is severe.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation: Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection).

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation: And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islamic Monotheism),

arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation: Owner of the throne, the Glorious

arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation: He does what He intends (or wills).

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation: Has the story reached you of the hosts,

arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation: Of Fir’aun (Pharaoh) and Thamud?

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation: Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad () and his Message of Islamic Monotheism).

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation: And Allah encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds).

arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation: Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’an,

arabic: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation: (Inscribed) in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz (The Preserved Tablet)!

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation: By the heaven, and At-Tariq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation: And what will make you to know what At-Tariq (night-comer) is?

arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation: (It is) the star of piercing brightness;

arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels incharge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds, etc.)

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation: So let man see from what he is created!

arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation: He is created from a water gushing forth

arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation: Proceeding from between the back-bone and the ribs,

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation: Verily, (Allah) is Able to bring him back (to life)!

arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation: The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).

arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation: Then will (man) have no power, nor any helper.

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation: By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation: And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants),

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation: Verily! This (the Qur’an) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict legal laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation: And it is not a thing for amusement.

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation: Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad ()).

arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation: And I (too) am planning a plan.

arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal you gently with them for a while.

arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation: Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it;

arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation: And Who has measured (preordainments for each and everything even to be blessed or wretched); then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture);

arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
