translation: And Who brings out the pasturage,

arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation: And then makes it dark stubble.

arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation: We shall make you to recite (the Qur’an), so you (O Muhammad ()) shall not forget (it),

arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation: Except what Allah, may will, He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.

arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation: And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad ()) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).

arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation: Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).

arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation: The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allah),

arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation: But it will be avoided by the wretched,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation: Who will enter the great Fire and made to taste its burning,

arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation: Wherein he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation: Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islamic Monotheism) shall achieve success,

arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation: And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allah), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawafil additional prayers).

arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation: Nay, you prefer the life of this world;

arabic: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
translation: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation: Verily! This is in the former Scriptures,

arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
translation: The Scriptures of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Musa (Moses).

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ
translation: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection);

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians, etc.).

arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
translation: Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allah), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace) .

arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
translation: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire,

arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
translation: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,

arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
translation: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,

arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
translation: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
translation: (Other) faces, that Day, will be joyful,

arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
translation: Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism).

arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation: In a lofty Paradise.

arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood,

arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation: Therein will be a running spring,

arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation: Therein will be thrones raised high,

arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation: And cups set at hand.

arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation: And cushions set in rows,

arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation: And rich carpets (all) spread out.

arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?

arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation: And at the heaven, how it is raised?

arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation: And at the mountains, how they are rooted and fixed firm?

arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation: And at the earth, how it is spread out?

arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation: So remind them (O Muhammad ()), you are only a one who reminds.

arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation: You are not a dictator over them.

arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves

arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation: Verily, to Us will be their return;

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
translation: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.

arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
translation: By the dawn;

arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
translation: By the ten nights (i.e. the first ten days of the month of Dhul-Hijjah),

arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
translation: And by the even and the odd (of all the creations of Allah).

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
translation: And by the night when it departs.

arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
translation: There is indeed in them (the above oaths) sufficient proofs for men of understanding (and that, they should avoid all kinds of sins and disbeliefs, etc.)!

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
translation: Did you (O Muhammad ()) not see (thought) how your Lord dealt with ‘Ad (people)?

arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
translation: Who were very tall like lofty pillars,

arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
translation: The like of which were not created in the land?

arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
translation: And (with) Thamud (people), who cut (hewed) out rocks in the valley (to make dwellings)?

arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation: And (with) Fir’aun (Pharaoh), who had pegs (who used to torture men by binding them to pegs)?

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
translation: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allah).

arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
translation: And made therein much mischief.

arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
translation: So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and gifts, then he says (puffed up): “My Lord has honoured me.”

arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation: But when He tries him, by straitening his means of life, he says: “My Lord has humiliated me!”

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation: Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)!

arabic: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation: And urge not on the feeding of AlMiskin (the poor)!

arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation: And you devour inheritance all with greed,

arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation: And you love wealth with much love!

arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation: Nay! When the earth is ground to powder,

arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation: And your Lord comes with the angels in rows,

arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?

arabic: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation: He will say: “Alas! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my life!”

arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation: So on that Day, none will punish as He will punish.

arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation: And none will bind as He will bind.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation: (It will be said to the pious): “O (you) the one in (complete) rest and satisfaction!

arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation: “Come back to your Lord, Well-pleased (yourself) and well-pleasing unto Him!

arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation: “Enter you, then, among My honoured slaves,

arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation: “And enter you My Paradise!”

arabic: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation: I swear by this city (Makkah);

arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation: And you are free (from sin, to punish the enemies of Islam on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah),

arabic: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation: And by the begetter (i.e. Adam) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny);

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation: Verily, We have created man in toil.

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
translation: Thinks he that none can overcome him?

arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا
translation: He says (boastfully): “I have wasted wealth in abundance!”

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation: Thinks he that none sees him?

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
translation: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?

arabic: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
translation: And a tongue and a pair of lips?

arabic: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
translation: And shown him the two ways (good and evil)?

arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
translation: But he has made no effort to pass on the path that is steep.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
translation: And what will make you know the path that is steep?

arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
translation: (It is) Freeing a neck (slave, etc.)

arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
translation: Or giving food in a day of hunger (famine),

arabic: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
translation: To an orphan near of kin.

arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
translation: Or to a Miskin (poor) afflicted with misery.

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation: Then he became one of those who believed, and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation: They are those on the Right Hand (the dwellers of Paradise),

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).

arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.

arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation: And by the sun and its brightness;

arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation: And by the moon as it follows it (the sun);

arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation: And by the day as it shows up (the sun’s) brightness;

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation: And by the night as it conceals it (the sun);

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation: And by the heaven and Him Who built it;

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation: And by the earth and Him Who spread it,

arabic: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation: And by Nafs (Adam or a person or a soul, etc.), and Him Who perfected him in proportion;

arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation: Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him;

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation: Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allah ordered, by following the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds).

arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation: And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself (i.e. disobeys what Allah has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism or by following polytheism, etc. or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds).

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation: Thamud (people) denied (their Prophet) through their transgression (by rejecting the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin).

arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation: When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).

arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation: But the Messenger of Allah [Salih (Saleh)] said to them: “Be cautious! Fear the evil end. That is the she-camel of Allah! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!”

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction (i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)!

arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation: And He (Allah) feared not the consequences thereof.

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation: By the night as it envelops;

arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation: And by the day as it appears in brightness;

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation: And by Him Who created male and female;

arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes);

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation: As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah and fears Him,

arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation: And believes in Al-Husna.

arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation: We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.

arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation: And gives the lie to Al-Husna (see Verse No: 6 footnote);

arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation: We will make smooth for him the path for evil;

arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation: And what will his wealth benefit him when he goes down (in destruction).

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation: Truly! Ours it is (to give) guidance,

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).

arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation: Therefore I have warned you of a Fire blazing fiercely (Hell);

arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation: None shall enter it save the most wretched,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation: Who denies and turns away.

arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation: And Al-Muttaqun (the pious and righteous – see V.2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell).

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation: He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,

arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation: And have in his mind no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,

arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation: Except only the desire to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High;

arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation: He surely will be pleased (when he will enter Paradise).

arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation: By the forenoon (after sun-rise);

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation: And by the night when it is still (or darkens);

arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation: Your Lord (O Muhammad ()) has neither forsaken you nor hated you.

arabic: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).

arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation: And verily, your Lord will give you (all i.e. good) so that you shall be well-pleased.

arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation: Did He not find you (O Muhammad ()) an orphan and gave you a refuge?

arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation: And He found you unaware (of the Qur’an, its legal laws, and Prophethood, etc.) and guided you?

arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation: And He found you poor, and made you rich (selfsufficient with selfcontentment, etc.)?

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression,

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation: And repulse not the beggar;

arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).

arabic: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad ())?

arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation: And removed from you your burden,

arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation: Which weighed down your back?

arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation: And raised high your fame?

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: So verily, with the hardship, there is relief,

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: Verily, with the hardship, there is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).

arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation: So when you have finished (from your occupation), then stand up for Allah’s worship (i.e. stand up for prayer).

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your intentions and hopes and) your invocations.

arabic: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation: By the fig, and the olive,

arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation: By Mount Sinai,

arabic: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation: And by this city of security (Makkah) ,

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation: Verily, We created man of the best stature (mould),

arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low,

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation: Save those who believe (in Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise).

arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation: Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. Day of Resurrection)?

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation: Is not Allah the Best of judges?

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation: Read! In the Name of your Lord, Who has created (all that exists),

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation: Has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
translation: Who has taught (the writing) by the pen [the first person to write was Prophet Idrees (Enoch)],

arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
translation: Has taught man that which he knew not.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
translation: Nay! Verily, man does transgress all bounds (in disbelief and evil deed, etc.).

arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
translation: Because he considers himself self-sufficient.

arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
translation: Surely! Unto your Lord is the return.

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
translation: Have you (O Muhammad ()) seen him (i.e. Abu Jahl) who prevents,

arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
translation: A slave (Muhammad ()) when he prays?

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation: Tell me, if he (Muhammad ()) is on the guidance (of Allah)?

arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
translation: Or enjoins piety?

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation: Tell me if he (the disbeliever, Abu Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Qur’an), and turns away?

arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
translation: Knows he not that Allah does see (what he does)?

arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
translation: Nay! If he (Abu Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock,

arabic: نَاصِيَةٍ كَـٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ
translation: A lying, sinful forelock!

arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
translation: Then, let him call upon his council (of helpers),

arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation: We will call the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!

arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation: Nay! (O Muhammad ())! Do not obey him (Abu Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allah!

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation: Verily! We have sent it (this Qur’an) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree)

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation: And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is?

arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation: The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allah in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, i.e. 83 years and 4 months).

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation: Therein descend the angels and the Ruh [Jibrael (Gabriel)] by Allah’s Permission with all Decrees,

arabic: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation: Peace! (All that night, there is Peace and Goodness from Allah to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.

arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation: Those who disbelieve from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and among Al-Mushrikun,were not going to leave (their disbelief) until there came to them clear evidence.

arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation: A Messenger (Muhammad ()) from Allah, reciting (the Qur’an) purified pages [purified from Al-Batil (falsehood, etc.)].

arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation: Containing correct and straight laws from Allah.

arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation: And the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) differed not until after there came to them clear evidence. (i.e. Prophet Muhammad () and whatever was revealed to him).

arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation: And they were commanded not, but that they should worship Allah, and worship none but Him Alone (abstaining from ascribing partners to Him), and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and give Zakat: and that is the right religion.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation: Verily, those who disbelieve (in the religion of Islam, the Qur’an and Prophet Muhammad ()) from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikun will abide in the Fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allah, and in His Messenger Muhammad ()) including all obligations ordered by Islam] and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures.

arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation: Their reward with their Lord is ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity), underneath which rivers flow, they will abide therein forever, Allah Well-Pleased with them, and they with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord.

arabic: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation: When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.

arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation: And when the earth throws out its burdens,

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation: And man will say: “What is the matter with it?”

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation: That Day it will declare its information (about all what happened over it of good or evil).

arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation: Because your Lord has inspired it.

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation: So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.

arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.

arabic: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation: By the (steeds) that run, with panting (breath),

arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves),

arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation: And scouring to the raid at dawn

arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation: Penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe);

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation: Verily! Man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord;

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation: And to that fact he bears witness (by his deeds);

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.

arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are brought out and poured forth (all mankind is resurrected).

arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: And that which is in the breasts (of men) shall be made known.

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds), (and will reward them for their deeds).

arabic: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation: Al-Qari’ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection),

arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation: What is the striking (Hour)?

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation: And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is?

arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about,

arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
translation: And the mountains will be like carded wool,

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
translation: Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy,

arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation: He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise).

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
translation: But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light,

arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌ
translation: He will have his home in Hawiyah (pit, i.e. Hell).

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
translation: And what will make you know what it is?

arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
translation: (It is) a hot blazing Fire!

arabic: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
translation: The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things diverts you,

arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
translation: Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die).

arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Nay! You shall come to know!

arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Again, Nay! You shall come to know!

arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have occupied yourselves in worldly things)

arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
translation: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)!

arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!

arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: Then, on that Day, you shall be asked about the delight (you indulged in, in this world)!

arabic: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
translation: By Al-‘Asr (the time).

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
translation: Verily! Man is in loss,

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation: Except those who believe (in Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, and recommend one another to the truth (i.e. order one another to perform all kinds of good deeds (Al-Ma’ruf)which Allah has ordained, and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds (Al-Munkar)which Allah has forbidden), and recommend one another to patience (for the sufferings, harms, and injuries which one may encounter in Allah’s Cause during preaching His religion of Islamic Monotheism or Jihad, etc.).

arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ
translation: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
translation: Who has gathered wealth and counted it,

arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
translation: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
translation: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?

arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
translation: The fire of Allah, kindled,

arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
translation: Which leaps up over the hearts,

arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ
translation: Verily, it shall be closed in on them,

arabic: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation: In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars, etc.).

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation: Have you (O Muhammad ()) not seen how your Lord dealt with the Owners of the Elephant? [The elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka’bah at Makkah].

arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation: Did He not make their plot go astray?

arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation: And sent against them birds, in flocks,

arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation: Striking them with stones of Sijjil.

arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation: And made them like an empty field of stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle).

arabic: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation: (It is a great Grace and Protection from Allah), for the taming of the Quraish,

arabic: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation: (And with all those Allah’s Grace and Protections for their taming, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south), and in summer (to the north without any fear),

arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation: So let them worship (Allah) the Lord of this House (the Ka’bah in Makkah).

arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation: (He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation: Have you seen him who denies the Recompense?

arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation: That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly),

arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation: And urges not the feeding of AlMiskin (the poor),

arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation: So woe unto those performers of Salat (prayers) (hypocrites),

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation: Who delay their Salat (prayer) from their stated fixed times,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation: Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men),

arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation: And refuse Al-Ma’un (small kindnesses e.g. salt, sugar, water, etc.).

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad ()) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise);

arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).

arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation: For he who makes you angry (O Muhammad ()), – he will be cut off (from every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).

arabic: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
translation: Say (O Muhammad () to these Mushrikun and Kafirun): “O Al-Kafirun (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar, etc.)!

arabic: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation: “I worship not that which you worship,

arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation: “Nor will you worship that which I worship.

arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation: “And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.

arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation: “Nor will you worship that which I worship.

arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation: “To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islamic Monotheism).”

arabic: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
translation: When comes the Help of Allah (to you, O Muhammad () against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah),

arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
translation: And you see that the people enter Allah’s religion (Islam) in crowds,

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
translation: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask for His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and forgives.

arabic: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
translation: Perish the two hands of Abu Lahab (an uncle of the Prophet), and perish he!

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
translation: His wealth and his children (etc.) will not benefit him!

arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ
translation: He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames!

arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
translation: And his wife too, who carries wood (thorns of Sadan which she used to put on the way of the Prophet () , or use to slander him).

arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
translation: In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad (palm fibre).

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
translation: Say (O Muhammad ()): “He is Allah, (the) One.

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
translation: “Allah-us-Samad (The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He neither eats nor drinks).

arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
translation: “He begets not, nor was He begotten;

arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
translation: “And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him.”

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
translation: Say: “I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of the daybreak,

arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation: “From the evil of what He has created;

arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
translation: “And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away).

arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
translation: “And from the evil of the witchcrafts when they blow in the knots,

arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation: “And from the evil of the envier when he envies.”

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: Say: “I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of mankind,

arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: “The King of mankind,

arabic: إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: “The Ilah (God) of mankind,

arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
translation: “From the evil of the whisperer (devil who whispers evil in the hearts of men) who withdraws (from his whispering in one’s heart after one remembers Allah) ,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: “Who whispers in the breasts of mankind,

arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
translation: “Of jinns and men.”
